entities.summary: Rana Tanveer Hussain is a Pakistani politician who is current serving as Minister for National Food Security and Research and also serving as Minister of Industries and Production since 11 March 2024 and serving as Member of the National Assembly of Pakistan since 29 February 2024. He has been a member of the National Assembly of Pakistan since February 2024. He was a member of the National Assembly between 1985 and August 2023.
